  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
      Two gliders in the 3D version of Robert Munafo's "U-skate world". One was found by Tim Hutton, and travels in a straight line. The other is the same but with one spot added, causing it to travel in a helical path. The 2D patterns on which these are based are described at <a href="http://mrob.com/pub/comp/xmorphia/uskate-world.html">http://mrob.com/pub/comp/xmorphia/uskate-world.html</a>.
    </description>
    <rule name="Gray-Scott" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.164
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.082
      </param>
      <param name="k">
        0.06093
      </param>
      <param name="F">
        0.062
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="2">
        delta_a = D_a * laplacian_a - a*b*b + F*(1.0f-a);
delta_b = D_b * laplacian_b + a*b*b - (F+k)*b;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
